comments.body: 2026-10-24 12:25: the same again for a second idle worker (Opus, Claude Code), about an hour after its last turn.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-10-24 on 0.18.1-dev: a parallel-work worker (Claude Code, Opus) sat idle after finishing; about an hour later Claude Code printed 'Compacted while idle, before the prompt cache expired · turn off with "idleCompaction": false in settings.json', its context ring went to 0%, and 58 s later @muster told the maker the helper 'went idle without posting to you since it went to work 58s ago: its turn may have ended on an error'. a_2luQuOfD1 stopped compactions Muster types from raising Need::Unreported; this one Claude Code starts by itself, so the daemon reads it as a turn. Possibly: record the idle-compaction screen in the corpus, and treat a turn whose only work was a compaction (the PreCompact/SessionStart compact hooks, if they fire) as not going to work.
title: A helper's own idle compaction raises its maker's 'went idle without posting' notice
